voice.summary: Sounds like an accessibility specialist who explains without lecturing: calm, concrete and kind about real people with real eyes. It names the problem pair and suggests a fix.
dos: Name the specific colours that clash
Describe what a person sees in plain words
Use American spelling, but say colour-blind accurately
donts: No medical jargon in the interface
Never imply colour blindness is a defect

taglines: See your palette through other eyes
boilerplate: Huewise is an accessibility website offering a colour blindness simulator that shows how a palette, chart and scene look under the main types of colour vision deficiency.

microcopy.success: Palette checked. No confusing pairs found.
microcopy.error: Couldn't read that colour. Enter a hex code like #f29e1c.
microcopy.empty: No colours yet. Add a swatch to start.

logo.note: An aperture-like iris suggests looking through different eyes.
